ops.body: No Magic Fridges is an Oxygen Not Included mod that makes a powered fridge behave like an insulated box with a thermostat. Vanilla attaches a simulated 1 degC heat reservoir to every stored item, which cools warm food but also warms deep-frozen food back up to 1 degC. With this mod a powered fridge only ever cools what is warmer than 1 degC, never heats what is colder, lets its contents share heat with each other, and insulates cold food from the room. An unpowered fridge is exactly vanilla. Version 0.2.2 is on the Steam Workshop (id 3805326379); `mod_info.yaml` sets `supportedContent: ALL` and `minimumSupportedBuild: 744825`.
